SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT c.id, c.name_kana, c.name, c.name_abbreviation, c.billing_customer_id, inv.last_billing_end_date AS billing_end_date FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.bill_to_customer_id, MAX(i.billing_end_date) AS last_billing_end_date FROM invoice AS i GROUP BY i.bill_to_customer_id ) AS inv ON inv.bill_to_customer_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(c.billing_customer_id, 0), c.id) WHERE TRIM(c.name_kana) LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(':1'), '%') OR TRIM(c.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(':2'), '%') OR TRIM(c.name_abbreviation) LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(':2'), '%') ORDER BY c.id

SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.bill_to_customer_id, MAX(i.billing_end_date) AS last_billing_end_date FROM invoice AS i GROUP BY i.bill_to_customer_id ) AS inv ON inv.bill_to_customer_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(c.billing_customer_id, 0), c.id) WHERE TRIM(c.name_kana) LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(':1'), '%') OR TRIM(c.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(':2'), '%') OR TRIM(c.name_abbreviation) LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(':2'), '%') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit_flag;
